transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?

Hello. Um... well. I guess I'm just here because... I don't know, I just feel like I'm always up and moving. Even when it's supposed to be a quiet day at home. I just sort of... bounce around. From the garden club list to my knitting bag... then maybe looking at some travel papers. I just... I don't really finish any one thing before moving on to the next.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually elevated or euphoric?
No... I don't think so. I just feel normal, I suppose. Just... restless. But not euphoric or anything like that.
Have you had these attention and restlessness problems since you were a child?

Yes... I suppose so. Um... even back in grade school, the teachers used to tell my mother that I was... scattered. They said I was bright, but... I guess I was always losing my papers. And talking out of turn. I just... always wiggled in my seat before my work was done.
Have you ever had a time when you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt full of energy?
No, I don't... I don't think I've ever had anything like that. I just sleep my normal amount, I guess. I've never really felt like I didn't need it.
Do you find social situations confusing or hard to read?
No... not really. I understand people fine, I suppose. I don't... I don't find them confusing or anything. Just normal, really.
